readiness_policy: packet182 (re-bracket of packet176): both kernel-foreground-io views >=+0.5% over every warm spin-parent control; the win-path chain additionally needs >=+2%

definitions.transfer: transfer_wall_ms = head (token id + lookup rows) + tail (error/next_token) foreground transfer time
definitions.fill_bytes: same-position delta of cache.jsonl fill_bytes_total (submitted at that position start)
definitions.carrier_rule: head when head slope >= 0.6 x transfer slope, tail when <= 0.4 x, else both

A0.engine: copy engine: BCS foreground immediate list (copy-only ordinal, index 0, same engine as the maintenance fill list)

B0.engine: compute queue: CCS kernel stores/loads to USM host memory; no copy command on any queue

A1.engine: copy engine: BCS foreground immediate list (copy-only ordinal, index 0, same engine as the maintenance fill list)

B1.engine: compute queue: CCS kernel stores/loads to USM host memory; no copy command on any queue

A2.engine: copy engine: BCS foreground immediate list (copy-only ordinal, index 0, same engine as the maintenance fill list)

fill_lever_price.rule: (filled minus unfilled wall outside the transfer window) x filled fraction; ceiling for any fill pacing/deferral, not a projection

mechanism_readout.collapse_rule: max B slow fraction <= 0.5 x min warm A slow fraction AND every B transfer slope <= 0.5 x every warm A slope
mechanism_readout.moved_rule: every B wall slope per same-token fill MB > 0.5 x every warm A wall slope
mechanism_readout.verdict: confirmed: foreground transfers waited behind fill bytes on the shared copy engine; kernel I/O removes the wait
